# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta4

## Multi mower schedule and zone scoping fixes

- Prevents one mower from borrowing another mower's Navimower schedule when the selected mower has no managed Navimower schedule configured.
- Uses the selected member's `native_schedule_data` and native schedule switch when Multi mower Schedule falls back to the mower's native schedule.
- Keeps Single mower schedule discovery unchanged.
- Makes Multi mower zone-label pills clickable again while preserving the Single-view pill styling and overlap handling.
- Namespaces zone-label interaction by `entry_id + zone_id`, so identical zone IDs on two mower maps cannot collide.
- Opens the existing zone-details panel with the selected mower's zone progress, last-mowed / last-completed timestamps and cutting height when available.

This beta is intentionally narrow: combined map alignment, live trail, heading, notifications, controls and sessions are unchanged from 0.3.6-beta3.
